versions.content: Depending on the configurable parameters NvMBlockUseCrc and NvMCalcRamBlockCrc , NvM module shall allocate memory for the largest CRC used. Hint: NvM users must not know anything about C RC memory (e.g. size, location) for their data in a RAM block.
